methods.scope: Objective source-program diagnostics. No human S/Q, naturalness, humor or style-quality claim.
methods.bodyComposition: An independently revalidated STRUCTURAL program with exact source-slot coverage/provenance whose source-bound pieces cover at least two non-context relation roles and actually invert source-role order or change source sentence grouping. The emitted block must differ from its original source block. Source-bound forms count as replaced source roles, separately from copied pieces. Nominalization or fixed wording alone is structural-form-only, not body composition.
methods.grouping: Compare number of source GiNZA sentence spans intersecting the block to terminal-delimited output groups in reconstructed block text. This is a finite surface grouping diagnostic, not a syntactic oracle.
methods.proof: Production bounded validators are rerun from original IR; this is independent of the submitted plan but not an independently implemented linguistic oracle. Slot span partition/coverage is additionally calculated directly.
methods.selection: Pool, displayed, and first displayed counts are separated. Changed order and more candidates do not imply improved quality.
